headlines.title: Speaker Johnson: ‘I certainly pray’ Trump’s prediction on Iran war ending after midterms is ‘right’
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) says that the war with Iran is causing higher prices at home and that he hopes and prays that President Trump’s prediction that the fighting would end after the midterm elections is correct.

headlines.title: Obama says Democrats should have a ‘very clear plan’ on AI policy
headlines.description: Researchers at AI companies have been warning about safety risks, and industry leaders have called for a slowdown in development.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles complications, state’s third death this year
headlines.description: The 40-year-old woman died as the U.S. experiences its worst outbreak of the disease in 35 years.

headlines.title: Air Force officer recalls ‘free-falling’ after jet was shot down over Iran
headlines.description: In an interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes,” one of the two U.S. Air Force officers whose fighter jet was shot down over Iran in April detailed his harrowing ordeal.

headlines.title: Two researchers who left Anthropic and Google warn AI could become ‘uncontrollable’
headlines.description: After Jacob Coxon roiled the AI industry with his viral departure from Anthropic, two more researchers are speaking out about their concerns over AI safety.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Texas Republicans call out railroad commissioner candidate over racist post
headlines.description: Several prominent Texas Republicans on Sunday condemned a racist post by Bo French, a GOP candidate for statewide office to regulate Texas’ oil and gas industry.

headlines.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, cargo carrier involved in fatal Miami crash
headlines.description: Online retailer Amazon said Sunday it was suspending its use of cargo carrier 21 Air after one of its Amazon-branded aircraft crashed upon landing in Miami this month, killing five people.

headlines.description: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei are publicly calling to slow down development of new AI systems, adding to a week of warnings from researchers about the technology.

headlines.description: Shelton entered his first Grand Slam final hoping to end a drought of more than 20 years for American men at the New York tournament.
